public_label: Trial sets Duration to 0.3 days. Your stated range: 0.1 days to 0.5 days, with the qualification that it is likely, and no conditions recorded. For this scenario, Olumi proposes an equal-tail approximation: about one chance in four below 0.1 days and one in four above 0.5 days, based on Olumi's standard reading of a plain likely range, not on evidence about this case, with the limitation that how values spread between and beyond those ends is also Olumi's assumption. Your words did not specify those tail probabilities. Pressing records your original range as you stated it and adopts this approximation; you can instead change or reject it
